The user wants a clear and concise definition of physiotherapy. I think I'll focus on its goals, methods, and practitioners, keeping it brief. Physiotherapy (physical therapy) is a healthcare profession that assesses, treats, and prevents movement and function problems caused by injury, illness, disability, or aging. It uses evidence-based techniques—such as exercise therapy, manual therapy, education, and modalities like heat, cold, or electrical stimulation—to reduce pain, restore mobility and strength, improve performance, and enhance quality of life. Practitioners are licensed physiotherapists/physical therapists.
